tasks.parallelism_notes: Root task: creates LedgerService.get_issue/issue_history, normalize_issue_id and the list_issues severity filter (ledger/service.py) that TASK-4399 and TASK-4400 both call.

tasks.parallelism_notes: Depends on TASK-4398: op_ledger_list/op_ledger_show call LedgerService.list_issues(severity=), get_issue, issue_history and normalize_issue_id (ledger/service.py). Touches no file of TASK-4400, so the two can run concurrently.

tasks.title: CLI wikitoolkit ledger list / ledger show
tasks.parallelism_notes: Depends on TASK-4398: the CLI local branch awaits LedgerService.get_issue/issue_history/list_issues(severity=) and imports normalize_issue_id (ledger/service.py). Uses the ledger_list/ledger_show tool names only as strings, so no edge to TASK-4399.
